_comment: DIP (untrained U-Net) FPM reconstruction of 018 — uses fptrecon preprocessing + calibration; 30 iterations only (final state = 'DIP 30 iterations') | adapted for 036 bright-field subset (ring 1, 9 images; FZP dr = 200 nm)

dip._shift_mode_options: image: per-image lateral image shift (units: camera pixels; e.g. sample/optics drift); illumination: per-image illumination wave-vector correction (units: crop spectrum pixel dk). Both bounded by shift_max via tanh.
dip._select_comment: selected iteration = earliest evaluation with validation band misfit <= (1 + select_tol) x minimum
dip._mask_comment: mask_vignetted: FOV model excludes pixels where the model direct beam leaves the pupil (needed for large crops); off here to keep the 512-crop results as reported

_comment_previous: unfiltered solver-frame results of BLIS-FPM, the first method (keys a, phi, W, M, dk, kappa, hist); fptrecon work/nonlinear_*.npz has the same layout
